title: Cross-model consult request
description: What a caller hands to the other model. artifact_paths carries canonical paths for the callee to read itself; it is deliberately not a place to paste file contents.

objective.description: Why this consult is being made — the outcome the caller is trying to reach.

question.description: The bounded question. One question, not a work package.

artifact_paths.description: Repo-relative paths the callee should read directly. Prefer this over pasting content: it keeps the handoff exact rather than paraphrased.

expected.description: What shape of answer would be useful, e.g. 'rank the three options and name the failure mode of each'.
